{"id":"50193","instruction":"Modify my SUMPRODUCT formula in Excel to get a ranking that does not include duplicates. Currently, when two products have the same value, they receive the same rank, which messes up the sequence. The Category Rank in Column K is based on Net Sales values in Column B within each Item Class (Column I) in 'RS.Food' sheet. When items have the same Net Sales value in column B, they are assigned the same 'Category Rank' in Column K. I need sequential ranks so that I can generate a table to display my top-selling menu items in each category. Specifically, with my current setup, having two products ranked as 11, there is no item assigned to rank 12, which causes issues. For the items with the same Net Sales value in column B and within same Item Class in column I, assign sequential rank in the order of the listing of products in column K.
